title: An ordinary integral model for a locally finitely presented immersed stratum
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E a finite-dimensional normed ℚ_ℓ-algebra which is a normed field. Use the integral and rational condensed coefficients and their inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying topological space, let i:Y→X be an immersion, and let F be an internal module over i⁻¹E_X, pro-etale locally a cokernel of a map between two finite free i⁻¹E_X-modules, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. There is an internal i⁻¹O_E,X-module N which is locally finitely presented on a finite constructible locally closed stratification of Y [def-constructible-stratification], such that ordinary extension of scalars along i⁻¹(O_E,X→E_X) sends N to a module isomorphic to F. There is no claim here about arbitrary stratified F or a derived complex.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, especially its first paragraph; Proposition 6.8.4(6); local finite-presentation input from Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Example 3.1

proof.text: An immersion has topologically noetherian domain. Transport F across the coefficient pullback ring isomorphism, and transport local finite presentation by restriction of scalars along that isomorphism. Lift the small coefficient field by ULift to use the existing local-triviality theorem in the scheme universe; the up/down continuous-map ring isomorphism transports finite freeness back.

The lisse stratified-lattice theorem supplies constructible integral models on a finite refinement. Transport these models and their rationalization isomorphisms to the raw pulled-back coefficient rings expected by gluing, using the commuting coefficient square and uniqueness of left adjoints to restriction of scalars.

Apply the existing ordinary gluing theorem on the immersed domain. Transport the resulting model back across the original coefficient square. All transports preserve constructibility; no target signature or definition is changed.

proof_origin.note: C4: actual internal coefficient transport, universe lift for local triviality, finite stratification and separate gluing. The unit statement and its realized steps are preserved.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousConstructible_integral_stratum (X : Scheme.{u})
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion i]
    (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} i).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)))
    (hF : ProEtale.IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
      ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} i).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)) F) :
    ∃ N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
        ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} i).obj (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)),
      ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject
        ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} i).obj (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) N ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
        ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} i).map
          (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X))).obj N ≅ F)
